//: Mirrors the game's tsconfig.base.json strictness on purpose. A mod compiled under
looser rules than the engine is a mod whose types agreed with nothing: the seams
it implements are declared with exactOptionalPropertyTypes and
noUncheckedIndexedAccess on, and a hook that typechecks here and not there is a
hook that will be rejected by the only compiler that matters.
The repository root IS the mod folder - manifest.json and plugin.js sit beside the
source they are built from, because that pair is what the game fetches and hashes.
src/ holds the decision code: the world memory, the flow field, the threat
weights, and one file per errand.
No composite/declaration: nothing consumes this as a library. plugin.js is the
artefact, and esbuild produces it - tsc is only ever the typechecker here.
